description: From the Längfluh balcony above Saas-Fee, the Allalinhorn rises as a snow-and-ice summit on the high ridge, with the Fee Glacier crevassed in the middle ground. Dark rock ribs frame the ice, and the near slope is late-September rock and tawny alpine turf. The Open-Meteo cell for this balcony is fully overcast, so the peak reads under diffuse cloud with no hard sun. No new lift or crane is added.
